description: 80 independently authored native synthesis patches. Vox additions remain in Vocals. No audio assets.

Round Sub Kick.designNotes: Sine and low octave body with a short resonant low-pass transient; play low keys.

FM Thump Kick.designNotes: Quarter-ratio FM transient and rapid low body decay; pitched electronic kick.

Rubber Knock Kick.designNotes: Pulse and sub with a hollow band-pass knock.

Broken Speaker Kick.designNotes: Low saw/sine impulse with restrained grit and a darker longer thud.

Bright Wire Snare.designNotes: Broad noise attack, quick resonant filter fall and dry wire tail.

Hollow Room Snare.designNotes: Noise and pitched triangle with band-pass shell and longer room articulation.

Circuit Snap Snare.designNotes: Clocked-register noise, narrow crunchy transient and abrupt decay.

Paper Handclap.designNotes: Filtered noise through a short gated syllabic amplitude contour.

Wide Neon Clap.designNotes: High-passed noise with a softer onset and rapidly moving amplitude.

Tight Noise Hat.designNotes: Very short high-passed white noise tick.

Open Air Hat.designNotes: Longer airy noise tail above a lower high-pass corner.

Metal FM Hat.designNotes: Inharmonic high-ratio FM filtered into a hard metallic tick.

Pocket Shaker.designNotes: Band-limited noise with a rounded start and dry shake ending.

Bronze Splash Cymbal.designNotes: Broad noise splash blended with a high pulse resonance and long cymbal decay.

Soft Low Tom.designNotes: Low-ratio FM membrane with rounded low-pass tone.

Glass High Tom.designNotes: Brighter FM membrane with a faster ring and higher partial ratio.

Muted Bongo Knock.designNotes: Three harmonic dry wood-body attack with a high resonance peak.

Talking Drum Pulse.designNotes: Pulse membrane with a short upward filter motion and pitch wobble.

Dry Wood Clave.designNotes: Short bright Karplus string impulse with minimal sustain.

Hollow Temple Block.designNotes: Low-brightness modal body through a narrow band-pass.

Copper Cowbell.designNotes: Two detuned pulse resonances with a dense, short metal envelope.

Rimshot Chrome.designNotes: Inharmonic FM strike with a steep attack and resonant bright click.

Tiny Triangle Chime.designNotes: Long bright inharmonic FM metal ring with high-pass focus.

Sand Grain Tambourine.designNotes: Bright noise/pulse mixture with fast tremolo and a short splash.

Velvet Chamber Clarinet.designNotes: Dark odd-harmonic pulse with smooth breath-shaped filter onset.

Reedy Upper Clarinet.designNotes: Bright narrow pulse and sine layer with a small moving resonance.

Bass Clarinet Shadow.designNotes: Low vowel A/O reed resonance and an intimate noise floor.

Staccato Ebony Reed.designNotes: Short square reed with a pronounced falling filter and little release.

Oboe Morning Reed.designNotes: Bright nasal formant reed using an E vowel and subtle vibrato.

English Horn Warmth.designNotes: Lower formant shift, rounded O/E blend and a slower chamber swell.

Piccolo Oboe Call.designNotes: High nasal wavetable resonance with light pitch ornamentation.

Bassoon Walnut.designNotes: Wide pulse low reed with resonant harmonics and stable held tone.

Contrabassoon Air.designNotes: Breathy shifted U formants with a darker sustained body.

Bassoon Short Steps.designNotes: Short additive reed with a brighter high-partial edge.

Recorder Linen.designNotes: Two sine layers and a soft narrow spectrum for a simple fipple tone.

Tenor Recorder Breath.designNotes: Four additive harmonics and high-pass focus with a breathy contour.

Pocket Recorder Chirp.designNotes: Twelve-step digital sine with a gentle modal companion and fast articulation.

Silver Concert Flute.designNotes: Low-index FM breath-shaped harmonic edge rather than a sampled flute.

Alto Air Column.designNotes: Smooth I/U formants with more unvoiced air and restrained vibrato.

Piccolo Bright Thread.designNotes: Bright additive pipe with seven partials and a quick upper-register onset.

Bamboo Hollow Pipe.designNotes: Formant wavetable pipe with low-pass reed attack and subtle detuning.

Panpipe Cedar Puff.designNotes: Breathy vowel band and a short fading breath column.

Shakuhachi Dawn Air.designNotes: Original breath-heavy synthetic pipe with a rising vowel and slow pitch ornament.

Reed Pipe Harmonic Mist.designNotes: Hollow FM pipe using an odd three-to-one ratio and soft modulation decay.

Milwaukee Bounce Tine.designNotes: Compact bright FM keys for a fast bouncing keyboard riff.

Milwaukee Side Street Piano.designNotes: Dark modal key with short dry decay and a hollow mid emphasis.

Milwaukee Chrome Keys.designNotes: Sharp higher-ratio FM piano attack with a compact low-pass tail.

Milwaukee Rubber Key Snap.designNotes: Narrow pulse keyboard with a quick resonant filter flick.

Milwaukee Ice Corner Bell.designNotes: Cold noninteger FM bell, long enough to ring between sparse hits.

Milwaukee Copper Ping.designNotes: Short high-brightness modal ping with a narrow band-pass ring.

Milwaukee Glass Bounce.designNotes: Low FM ratio and strong moving operator depth create a hollow bell.

Milwaukee Pocket Music Bell.designNotes: Bright stepped sine/triangle blend with a fast digital ring.

Milwaukee Wire Flick Pluck.designNotes: Bright inharmonic FM wire-like flick with a short independent operator envelope, distinct from physical-string plucks.

Milwaukee Neon Toy Pluck.designNotes: Moving original wavetable in the hollow pulse family with a steep decay.

Milwaukee Bottle Tap.designNotes: Modal bottle-like knock with a dark filter and rapid ringing partials.

Milwaukee FM Knock Bass.designNotes: Low-ratio FM bass with a hard short transient and slightly held body.

Milwaukee Night Shift Bass.designNotes: Original wavetable bass using a hollow upper shape and low-pass movement.

Milwaukee Whistle Signal.designNotes: Thin sine/pulse whistle with a fast legato slide.

Milwaukee Arcade Turn Lead.designNotes: Crisp digital pulse with an animated filter and quick held body.

Milwaukee Horn Jab.designNotes: Fast saw/pulse brass stab with a pronounced filter-envelope peak.

Milwaukee Nasal Brass Pop.designNotes: Short formant reed brass with shifted A formants and light grit.

Milwaukee Bounce Ooh.designNotes: Short low rounded vowel with rhythmic spectral motion.

Milwaukee High Eh Cut.designNotes: High narrow E vowel stab with a brighter open formant and shorter decay.

Milwaukee Winter Window Pad.designNotes: Low-cost six-harmonic soft chord bed with gentle filter motion.

Milwaukee Lake Neon Pad.designNotes: Hollow wavetable chord texture with a shorter swell and spacious body.
